message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code does not fetch data from any remote source (URL, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) and therefore implements no checksum, authentication, or integrity verification for external data.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering on the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models in-memory using scikit-learn (GaussianNB, SVM) without loading any serialized/pretrained model files, so there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision applied to a loaded model artifact.

No detected label distribution validation: The code collects data and splits it for training but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples before fitting the model.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses scikit-learn's SVM and GaussianNB without any differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.).

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline; only standard accuracy scoring is performed.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path (predict_categories, predict_columns, classification_score) passes raw transaction text and session data directly to vectorization and the SVM model without any shape, range, type, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: The predict functions return the raw SVM predictions without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation before returning results to callers.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a traditional ML classifier (SVM/Naive Bayes), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
